integrity: The resonant invariants and the exact initial value of \(K\) are checked by dependency-free exact rational polynomial arithmetic.
The source equations and Figure 11 initial values were checked in the primary full text.
No finite numerical trajectory or finite-time Lyapunov estimate is used as proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns the \(2{:}1\) resonant forcing case used in Figure 11 and does not classify the incommensurate-frequency experiment.
The result proves a phase-leaf mismatch; it does not recompute or declare either numerical diagram individually incorrect.
Comparability could be restored by a separate proof of invariance of the relevant diagnostics under the resonant relative phase; no such theorem is established here.
title: A resonant phase invariant separates two KP-MEW-Burgers forcing diagnostics
